title: Pike Place Tour with Vegan and Vegetarian Tastings
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
For some, Plant-Based is a lifestyle. For others, it is a new way to think about food.

This tour visits restaurants that are selected by a local guide to showcase the best of Seattle and to highlight hidden gems within Pike Place Market.

Good food is good food. We don't let dietary restrictions limit us, so even those who eat everything will be impressed.

Enjoy an intimate glimpse into daily Market life. Along they way, come to understand Washington as a leader in agricultural and Seattle as an artisanal food capital.

Join us and see how good it can be!
